Property.Value: BEGIN -- CTE to calculate cumulative balance for each employee WITH BalanceTotals AS ( SELECT [ledger_id], [emp_id], [year], [date], [earned_vl], [earned_sl], [earned_bl], [earned_el], [add_vl], [add_sl], [balance_vl], [balance_sl], [balance_el], [salary_deduction], -- Calculate the cumulative total of balance_vl + balance_sl SUM([balance_vl] + [balance_sl]) OVER (PARTITION BY [emp_id] ORDER BY [date] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_balance FROM [dbo].[ledger] ) -- Insert records where cumulative balance >= 30 for the first time, and the employee isn't already recorded INSERT INTO [dbo].[force_leave_eligibility] ([emp_id], [date], [cumulative_balance]) SELECT [emp_id], [date], cumulative_balance FROM BalanceTotals WHERE cumulative_balance >= 30 AND NOT EXISTS ( -- Ensure employee isn't already recorded in the force_leave_eligibility table SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[force_leave_eligibility] WHERE [emp_id] = BalanceTotals.[emp_id] ) AND [date] = ( -- Select the first occurrence when the cumulative balance >= 30 for each employee SELECT MIN([date]) FROM BalanceTotals WHERE cumulative_balance >= 30 AND [emp_id] = BalanceTotals.[emp_id] ); END;
